title: Creating Hybrid Interactive Narrative Systems with LLM: From Formal Description to Evaluation
abstract: arXiv:2611.02807v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Interactive narratives let users shape a story while an Experience Manager (EM) keeps it coherent, balancing player freedom against authorial control. Large Language Models now enable a new generation of hybrid EMs, which combine run-time generation from free-text input with symbolic narrative control. However, their heterogeneity makes them hard to compare: A manager's behaviour is generally tied to the unique and specific scenario in which it operates, and much of its decision-making takes place outside of any explicit and verifiable structure. We address this with an LLM-based narrative platform whose managers are interchangeable modules operating over a shared symbolic world model of facts, operations, and goals. Because every applied operation carries explicit preconditions and effects, each session can be analysed as a plan through a common state-transition representation and evaluated, independently of how the manager works inte

translated_title: 基于大语言模型创建混合式交互叙事系统：从形式化描述到评估
translated_abstract: 交互式叙事让用户能够塑造故事，同时由体验管理者（Experience Manager，EM）保持故事的连贯性，在玩家自由与作者控制之间取得平衡。大语言模型如今催生了新一代的混合式体验管理者，它们将基于自由文本输入的运行时生成与符号化叙事控制相结合。然而，这些系统的异质性使其难以相互比较：管理者的行为通常与其运行的独特且特定的场景紧密绑定，其大部分决策过程发生在任何显式且可验证的结构之外。我们通过一个基于大语言模型的叙事平台来解决这一问题，该平台的管理者是可互换的模块，运行在一个由事实、操作和目标构成的共享符号世界模型之上。由于每个被应用的操作都带有明确的前提条件和效果，每个会话都可以通过统一的状态转移表示被分析为一个规划并进行评估，而不依赖于管理者内部的工作方式。
tldr: 提出了一个基于大语言模型的混合式交互叙事平台，通过让可互换的体验管理者模块运行于共享的符号世界模型之上，实现了对不同管理者的统一分析与评估。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an LLM-based hybrid interactive narrative platform in which interchangeable Experience Manager modules operate over a shared symbolic world model, enabling unified analysis and evaluation of different managers through a common state-transition representation.
